text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Hm, this? It's homework. I ended up 
falling asleep last night, so I couldn't 
get around to it.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
After all, I was fast asleep. Come to 
think of it, Durandal told me I was 
sleep-shouting, 'Kitty Paradise!!'

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
And you were even drooling, you say? No, 
please don't misunderstand, I made sure to 
draw the drool in a neat, straight line.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"It's true. Look, see? There's still some 
left right around here."
